lawyer: For the Petitioner: Mr. B. Hossain, Deputy Attorney General, instructed by Mvi. Md. Wahidullah, Advocate-on-Record. For the Respondent: Mr. Md. Aftab Hossain, Advocate-on-Record, Supreme Court.

The Principal Secretary, President's Secretariat, Old Sangsad Bhaban, Tejgaon, Dhaka and others ------ Petitioners.
Versus
Mohammad Abdul Baten  ------ Respondent.
full_judgment: 2. This petition is barred by limitation of 195 days. There is an application for con- ' donation of the delay. Grounds taken for condonation are that the relevant Ministry asked for legal opinion on 9-9-93 for filing a leave petition and also to get a certified copy of the High Court Division's order, that the file was sent to the Attorney General and then to the Additional Attorney General for opinion, that there-after, it was sent to the Solicitor "who was pleased to appoint an Advocate-on-Record," that the Solicitor's office asked the Ministry of Home Affairs for supplying necessary documents and papers, that thereafter, necessary fund was sought for ect. These are not at all good grounds for condonation of the delay; rather these show utter negligence, carelessness, inefficiency or, may be connivance of persons/officials of the petitioner-Government who handled this matter. When an Assistant Attorney General (Mr. Mashuque Hossain Ahmed) had appeared before the High Court Division and argued on behalf of the government he certainly knew of the result of the writ petition. As such certified copy of the impugned order could have been easily obtained in time. The writ petition .was filed four years after the impugned order of dismissal of the respondent under MLR-9. No Affidavit was filed raising questions as to its maintain-ability and inordinate delay. As to the delay in filing this leave petition, whether it was either deliberate or' due to utter negligence on the part of the petitioner's officers, there is no good ground for its condonation. It is better that strong action is taken against the persons responsible for failure to file Affidavit-in-Opposition in the writ petition and also for this delay in filing the leave petition.
